body: When Juice WRLD Got Off His Tour Bus In Front Of Fans, Some Of Them Took A Moment To Realize It Was Actually Him Despite His Rapid Rise To Fame, Juice Still Carried Himself Like A Regular Person. When Juice WRLD Got Off His Tour Bus In Front Of Fans, Some Of Them Took A Moment To Realize It Was Actually Him 😂👀

Despite His Rapid Rise To Fame, Juice Still Carried Himself Like A Regular Person. Juice’s Fame Was Growing At A Crazy Speed, But Moments Like This Showed How Low-Key He Still Was. 😂🔥
